shortDescription: Rock the fields with the Nova Rock 2026 Insider. Offline maps & lineup.
longDescription:
Survive the Pannonia dust storm with Nova Rock Insider 2026.

Built for the fields of Nickelsdorf, this app is your tactical edge. While others struggle with the network, you'll have instant access to stage times, site maps, and the official AI scout.

FEATURES:
- Rock Scout: AI recommendations for the best of rock, punk, and metal.
- Pannonia Map: High-performance SVG map of the Blue and Red stages.
- PlayPass Integration: Quick links to your cashless wristband management.
- Survival Toolkit: Essential local phrases and SOS beacon.
- Offline-First: Zero data required for the full experience.

Don't just attend Nova Rock. Rule it.
